questions.question: Explain the difference between a physical map and a political map.
questions.expected_answer: A physical map shows natural features such as mountains, rivers, plateaus and plains, and uses colours to show height above sea level. A political map shows borders between countries or provinces and the cities and capital cities, usually with each country in a different colour, but it does not show height.

questions.question: What is a thematic map? Give two examples.
questions.expected_answer: A thematic map shows one theme or topic. Examples include a rainfall map, a temperature map, a natural vegetation map, a population map, a farming map or a mining map. Each thematic map has its own key.

questions.question: Describe two kinds of statistics found in an atlas and explain why it is important to check the date of the atlas.
questions.expected_answer: An atlas may give the area of each country in square kilometres, its population, its capital and largest cities, its languages and its currency, and lists of the highest mountains or longest rivers. Statistics such as population change over time, so an old atlas may give out-of-date numbers.
